text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking through the city during the season when Halloween decorations could be seen everywhere—

text_block_list.name: Costumed Child
text_block_list.text: Trick or treeeat~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Treat!
Here, have some candy~!
choice_data_list: Mayano, were you handing out sweets?
Mayano, were you handing out sweets?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan! Fufun~♪
Right now, I'm showing everyone how mature Maya can be!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
On Halloween, kids get treats from adults, right?
So this year, I thought I'd be on the giving side!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you plenty of grown-up composure~!
Alright then, Maya-chin, take off!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Trick or treat! Give me sweets or get tricked—!
...Wait, Maya-chan, you're the one handing out sweets!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Here's your treat!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: All right, I guess I'll spare you from any pranks~!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You really look the part~!
All right then Maya-chan, do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah.
......

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so super happy!
Ehehe, Trainer-chan, praise me, praise me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mayano! Happy Halloween♪
Trick or treat~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pearl-san!
Maya's got some snacks for you!
Wait a second—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No questions asked, it's trick time~~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, heeeeere it comes!
Tickle-tickle-tickle-tickle~~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, st-stop, wait!!
That tickles, Pearl-saaaan?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! Maya tried to give you snacks, you know?
Breaking the rules is a no-no! Hmph!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Halloween is a festival
meant to vibrate the soul, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"A face that isn't enjoying things
from the bottom of its heart is plain as day!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Getting bound by convention is total nonsense!
You've just gotta enjoy yourself however you want.

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: All right, I guess I'll spare you from any pranks~!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You really look the part~!
All right then Maya-chan, do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Uuuughhh~~!!
Maya really... really wanted to~~...!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get lots of candy!!
And I wanna play tricks, lots and loooots of tricks too!!" his/her tone is energetic and childish like Haru Urara or Twin Turbo},
  {"id": 42, "en": "The smiles that sweets bring... I believe they come not just from the taste,
but from the heart of the maker as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right, do what you want to do, Mayano!
With the most important person in your life!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eye copy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan!
Trick or treat♪
choice_data_list: I've got plenty of snacks ready for you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~♪ I'll take the candy~. But here, it's trick AND treat~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Take this, this, this! Scribbling on your hand!
Let's see, "I wuv Mayano♡"—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Not yet~ Maya's Halloween has only just begun!
choice_data_list: Tell me what you want to do.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Like walking around town with Trainer-chan and Pearl-san in costume!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, sounds great!
That means it's party time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All together now: Take, oooooff!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go around and see all the other girls' costumes!
Everyone put so much effort into making theirs!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, I know just the street for that!
Let's parade down the Spooky Road!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, I wanna go try it~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure if I go out into town right now,
I can get all sorts of sweets.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's why we should do a taste-test comparison!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mufufu~ Scramble♪
Sweets and tricks are calling Maya's name~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I do have one really special idea...
But when I actually picture it, it's a bit...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... A smooch on the forehead or something?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hyawawa! Maya needs to be just
a little bit more grown up for that... right?
